title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 09 March 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 08 March 2026 Mainly dry weather will prevail over the island, except for showers or thundershowers that may occur at a few places in Southern province, and Rathnapura, Colombo and Kaluthara districts after 2.00 pm Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, North-central, Central, Sabaragamuwa, Uva and North-western provinces and in Mannar, Vavuniya, Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning.
